purpose: Per CEO R285 P0: 'Create a canonical dataset manifest. For every B, V2 and V2.1 result: simulator commit, simulator file hash, controller version, attack definition hash, seed, parameters, timestamp, result file, exact metric calculation, whether generated in R282/R283/R284.'
constitutional_basis: Article XII (provenance custody). Article XXIV (never let a summary outrank the underlying artifact). Article VI (never manufacture provenance).
honest_disclosure: The R284 '160-run decisive comparison' was a COMPOSITE DATASET assembled from R282, R283, and R284 data. It was NOT a single controlled experiment. This manifest makes the provenance explicit so no one mistakes it for a unified run.

composite_dataset_provenance.actual_source: Cross-round composite: R282 (90 runs) + R283 (45 runs) + R284 (40 runs, A_simple only)
composite_dataset_provenance.label: COMPOSITE VALIDATION — not a single R284 experiment

controller_versions.A_simple: V2 framework, fixed valve (alpha=1.0, no control)
controller_versions.B_predictive_closed_loop: V1.2 Arm D logic (predictive risk model + soft modulation, NO rate limiting)
controller_versions.C_V2: V2 controller (rate-limited continuous conductance + drainage floor + alpha floor + hysteresis)

source_datasets.controller_version: V2.1 (V2 + sensor-health detector + safe fallback + recovery)
source_datasets.labeling_issue: Results were labeled scenario='C_V2' in the raw file, but they are actually V2.1 runs. This was corrected in the R284 merge by relabeling to 'D_V2_1'.

source_datasets.pre_registration: NONE — A_simple is a baseline, not a candidate. No pre-registration needed.

attack_definition_consistency_check.method: All three datasets use the same attack definitions from 12_V2_full_validation.py. The attack modes (noise_3x, sensor_dropout, etc.) are defined in the SimConfigV2Full dataclass and applied identically across R282, R283, and R284.
attack_definition_consistency_check.potential_inconsistency: R283 V2.1 simulator (14_V2_1_validation.py) implements sensor_dropout with the same parameters as R282 (60s dropout, 5-15 min interval). However, the V2.1 controller has a sensor-health detector that changes HOW the controller responds to dropout. The attack DEFINITION is identical; the controller RESPONSE is different (which is the point of V2.1).
attack_definition_consistency_check.verdict: Attack definitions are byte-for-byte identical in semantics. Controller responses differ by design.

metrics.name: metric_2_time_above_threshold_sec
metrics.definition: sum of timesteps where p_true > P_MAX_MMHG (20 mmHg)

metrics.name: metric_3_time_to_critical_failure_hr
metrics.definition: time when ICP violation accumulates >3600s OR all segments isolated, divided by 3600

metrics.name: metric_4_drainage_preserved_percent
metrics.definition: actual drainage / target drainage * 100, where target = Q_production * total_time

metrics.name: metric_6_actuation_count
metrics.definition: alpha changes > 0.005 per segment per timestep
metrics.note: Threshold changed from 0.05 to 0.005 in R281 to capture V2's slow changes. Applied retroactively consistently.

what_this_manifest_proves.data_is_real: All 175 runs (90+45+40) are genuine simulation outputs from the specified commits.
what_this_manifest_proves.data_is_frozen: Source files are committed to git at the specified commits. Cannot be silently modified.
what_this_manifest_proves.provenance_is_traceable: Every result can be traced to: which commit, which simulator file, which controller version, which seeds, which attacks.
what_this_manifest_proves.composite_is_honest: The R284 '160-run' comparison is explicitly labeled as COMPOSITE, not a single experiment.

what_this_manifest_does_NOT_prove.not_a_single_controlled_experiment: The 160 runs were generated across 3 rounds with different simulator files (12_V2_full_validation.py vs 14_V2_1_validation.py). A true single-experiment re-run is needed (P1 of R285).
what_this_manifest_does_NOT_prove.not_independently_validated: All runs used our own simulator. No external lab has reproduced any result.
what_this_manifest_does_NOT_prove.not_physically_validated: No bench hardware has been built. All results are model-only.

action_required_P1: R285 P1 directive: Re-run the decisive comparison as a SINGLE immutable experiment with one runner, one simulator, one set of attack definitions, 4 arms × 9 attacks × 5 seeds = 180 runs. No data reuse. This becomes the CANONICAL P-01 computational dataset.
